prompt: Create a vertical anime-style portrait of a young Japanese bookstore clerk in a warmly lit bookstore aisle. She is centered in a close-up bust composition, facing the viewer with a gentle small smile and soft, expressive brown eyes. She has warm dark brown short bob hair with airy loose waves, wispy bangs covering the forehead, fine flyaway strands, and warm rim light outlining the top of her hair. She wears a slightly wrinkled cream button-up shirt under a navy bookstore apron with shoulder straps, metal strap buckles, a small white “BOOKS” logo on the chest, and a clipped rectangular staff name badge with Japanese text including 「店員」 and the name 「貝渕」. Add small stud earrings and natural rosy cheeks. She holds one visible book at the lower left edge of the frame, a teal-green hardcover with vertical Japanese title text. The background is a softly blurred bookstore interior with shelves on both sides, warm ceiling lights creating round bokeh, and a large out-of-focus Japanese sign on the left reading 「文庫・新書」 and 「話題の本」. Use cinematic golden-hour indoor lighting, slightly dark cozy exposure, shallow depth of field, detailed painterly anime rendering, delicate skin shading, realistic fabric folds, soft amber highlights, and a calm intimate atmosphere. Canvas ratio 2:3, portrait orientation. Avoid extra characters, avoid modern UI elements, avoid watermarks, and keep all background text blurred except the badge and apron logo.

promptZh: 创作一张竖版动漫风格肖像，描绘一位年轻的日本书店店员，背景位于灯光暖黄的书店过道中。构图为居中的半身特写，她面向观众，带着温柔的浅笑，眼神棕色且富有表现力。她留着 暖深棕色 的短波波头，带有轻盈的波浪感，额前有稀疏的刘海和细碎的发丝，发顶有温暖的轮廓光。她身穿一件略带褶皱的米色衬衫，外罩一件海军蓝书店围裙，围裙带有肩带、金属扣，胸前印有白色“BOOKS”小标志，并别着一个长方形员工名牌，上面写有日文「店员」及名字「貝渕」。添加小巧的耳钉和自然的红润脸颊。她左下角的手中拿着一本书，为青绿色精装本，封面上印有竖排日文标题。背景是柔焦处理的书店内部，两侧是书架，温暖的顶灯营造出圆形的散景效果，左侧有一个虚化的日文大招牌，写着「文庫・新書」和「話題の本」。采用电影感的黄金时段室内光效，略暗的温馨曝光，浅景深，细腻的绘画风动漫渲染，精致的皮肤阴影，逼真的布料褶皱，柔和的琥珀色高光，营造出宁静亲密的氛围。画布比例 2:3，竖向构图。避免出现多余角色，避免现代 UI 元素，避免水印，除名牌和围裙标志外，保持所有背景文字模糊。
